Bio Nitrile Gloves feature an advanced biodegradable property formulated to attract microbes in landfills to break down 80% of the glove in less than 1.5 years. Strong puncture resistance while maintaining high dexterity. Compact and recycled packaging to reduce material waste, storage space, and shipping cost. Textured fingertips provide excellent grip under all operating conditions.

Product Details

  • 2.2 - 2.5 mils Thickness
  • Fingertip Textured
  • Ambidextrous
  • Nitrile
  • Non-Sterile
  • Blue color
